Inline enum values:

#### `parameter_channel_specific`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `global_module` | Parameter monitored globally for the module |
| 0x01 | `channel_specific` | Parameter monitored for a channel selected by bits 1:0 |

Polymorphic variants:

#### `param_value`

Discriminated by `parameter_type[param]`:

| When | Type / enum | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `u16be` | Parameter not supported; value ignored |
| 0x01 | `u16be` | SNR, line ingress |
| 0x02 | `i16be` | Residual ISI or dispersion |
| 0x03 | `u16be` | PAM4 level transition parameter |
| 0x04–0x05 | `f16be` | Average BER or FER using SFF-8636 base-10 F16 encoding |
| 0x06 | `i16be` | TEC current |
| 0x07 | `i16be` | Laser frequency difference |
| 0x08 | `i16be` | Laser temperature difference |
| 0x09–0x10 | `f16be` | Latched, prior, or current BER/FER using SFF-8636 base-10 F16 encoding |
| 0x11–0xFF | `u16be` | Reserved or vendor-specific parameter carried as raw U16 |
